title: Drew Brees will join Saints' Ring of Honor on Oct. 11

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Drew Brees will join Saints' Ring of Honor on Oct. 11
sources.description: Hall of Famer Drew Brees will enter the Saints' Ring of Honor on Oct. 11 during halftime for the team's game against the Vikings, the team announced Tuesday.
